new_gidar = #{userLogin.newGidar},
new_sign_up = #{userLogin.newSignUp},

new_follow_activity = #{userLogin.newFollowActivity},

mapper.select: select count(1) from corgi_user_detail where user_id = #{userId}

select d.`user_id` userId, `nickname`, `avatar`, avatar_status avatarStatus, `height`, `weight`, `desc`, `role`, `character`, `group`, `birthday`, `con`, `city`, l.im_id imId, l.tel_no telNo, p.lat lat, p.lng lng, p.uptime `time`, `check_status` checkStatus from corgi_user_detail d left join corgi_user_login l on l.id = d.user_id left join corgi_user_position p on p.user_id = d.user_id where d.user_id = #{userId}
select count(1) from corgi_user_detail where birthday >= #{beginDate} and birthday < #{endDate}

select count(1) from corgi_user_detail
where (`nickname` = #{nickname} or `check_nickname` = #{nickname})
where (`nickname` = #{checkNickname} or `check_nickname` = #{checkNickname})
and user_id != #{userId}
select user_id userId, lat, lng from corgi_user_position where user_id = #{userId}
select user_id userId, lat, lng from corgi_user_position limit #{start}, #{size}
mapper.update: update corgi_user_position set lat = #{lat}, lng = #{lng}, uptime = #{uptime}, pt=point(#{lng},#{lat}) where user_id = #{userId}
update corgi_user_position set uptime = #{uptime} where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select p.user_id userId, p.lat lat, p.lng lng, p.uptime `time`, d.nickname `nickname`, d.avatar avatar, d.avatar_status avatarStatus, d.role role, d.group `group`, d.con con, d.check_status checkStatus, l.tel_no telNo, l.im_id imId from corgi_user_position p left join corgi_user_detail d on d.user_id = p.user_id left join corgi_user_login l on l.id = d.user_id where p.user_id in ${inValue}
select count(1) from corgi_user_position where uptime >= #{beginTime} and uptime <= #{endTime}
select count(1) from corgi_user_position p left join corgi_user_login l on p.user_id = l.id where p.uptime >= #{time} and l.ctime like concat(#{date},'%')
select count(1) from corgi_user_login where ctime like concat(#{date},'%')
